errors.text_span: zeigt den Anteil der Betriebe in Prozent, die von der Mindestlohnanhebung auf 12 Euro betroffen sind
errors.evidence: The chart purpose is about the percentage share of different sectors and business sizes among all businesses, not about minimum wage impact. The reference and atom checklist confirm this.
The description does not mention the y-axis label 'Anteil an allen Betrieben in %' or the exact scale details (e.g., gap in axis).
The vertical axis has 23 categories (19 sectors + 4 business size categories), not 19 sectors + 3 business sizes. The atom checklist confirms 23 categories.
The description omits the category 'Kleinbetriebe (10-49)', which is present in the figure and atom checklist.
The figure shows 'Nahrungs- und Genussmittel' with approximately 48%, not 45%.
The figure shows 'Einzelhandel' with approximately 45%, not 40%.

errors.evidence: The figure shows 'Baugewerbe' at approximately 8% and 'Finanz- und Versicherungsgewerbe' at approximately 12%, not 10% for both.
The figure shows 'Mittlere Betriebe (50-249)' at approximately 39%, not 38%.
The figure shows 'Kleinstbetriebe (1-9)' at approximately 19%, not 20%.

errors.text_span: die von der Mindestlohnanhebung auf 12 Euro betroffen sind
errors.evidence: The figure and atom checklist do not mention minimum wage impact; this is an unsupported interpretation.
While technically correct, the phrasing implies a focus on classification rather than the chart's actual purpose (percentage share). This adds unnecessary interpretation.
